catalog.title: Product Catalog
catalog.description: Browse our brochure-backed hospital, kitchen, washroom, industrial, and laundry products. Filter by category, application, and certifications to find the right solution for your facility.
catalog.footer: Mamta Associates. All rights reserved. Powered by Haylide Green Cleaning Technology.

home.heroDescription: Manufacturing over 90 specialty products for Housekeeping, Infection Control, Medical, Food-Pharma, and Laundry. Delivering FDA-licensed efficacy with uncompromising environmental safety.
home.catalogDescription: Our complete range is designed for critical hygiene needs, reducing inventory and training costs while ensuring resource, manpower, and utility savings.

products.title: Sterimop Disinfectant Floor & Hard Surface Cleaner
products.active: Benzalkonium Chloride 3% w/v with alcohol and food-safe additives
products.molecule: A benzalkonium chloride system with ethanol helps clean and disinfect floors and hard surfaces in a neutral pH format.
products.dilution: Dilution: 1% or 10 ml/ltr. Use with floor mopping, spray and wipe, or machine scrub as required.
products.impact: Low-VOC formulation designed for general area cleaning with reduced solvent load and improved indoor safety.

products.title: Sterimop HF Disinfectant Floor & Hard Surface Cleaner
products.active: Benzalkonium Chloride with pine oil fragrance for heavy deodorizing applications
products.molecule: A fragranced disinfectant base for floor and hard-surface cleaning when deodorizing performance is the priority.
products.dilution: Use at 1% to 2% depending on the freshness and sheen required for floor mopping and spray wiping.
products.impact: Readily biodegradable cleaner developed for indoor hygiene where a stronger fragrance profile is preferred.

products.title: LFRA - Floor Cleaner & Disinfectant
products.active: Benzalkonium Chloride 4% w/v with alcohol and food-safe additives
products.molecule: A food-area floor disinfectant built around benzalkonium chloride, natural-source surfactants, and sodium gluconate.
products.dilution: Dilution: 2% to 5% or 20 to 50 ml/ltr. Use for spray, foam, or mop cleaning with the indicated contact time.
products.impact: Designed for food-industry hygiene with biodegradable ingredients and reduced synthetic solvent content.

products.title: STERISHINE LFRA Disinfectant Floor & Hard Surface Cleaner
products.active: Neutral hard-surface cleaner with ethanol, chelates, and food-safe surfactants
products.molecule: A neutral disinfectant cleaner for critical-area floors and hard surfaces, tuned for low residue and easy wipe-off.
products.dilution: Use at 1% to 3% depending on the floor shine, freshness, and disinfection demand.
products.impact: Formulated for safer hospital housekeeping with lower solvent load and strong surface compatibility.

products.title: OxyCleanz+ Multi-Surface Cleaner & Disinfectant
products.active: Hydrogen Peroxide 5% w/v with non-ionic surfactants and chelating agents
products.molecule: Hydrogen peroxide provides rapid oxidation while the surfactant and chelate system helps lift residues from hard surfaces.
products.dilution: Dilution: 1:200 or 0.5% / 5 ml/ltr. Use with a dilutor for spray, mop, or machine scrub cleaning.
products.impact: Readily biodegradable and free from NPE, caustic, EDTA, chlorides, and synthetic solvents.

products.title: Kleen & Shine Hard Surface Cleaner & Disinfectant+
products.active: Hydrogen Peroxide + peracetic acid with ethanol and chelates
products.molecule: An accelerated peroxide system designed for easy spray-and-wipe disinfection on hard surfaces and equipment.
products.dilution: Ready to use on hard surfaces. Spray and wipe for soil removal and disinfection in a single step.
products.impact: Eco-green formula built around naturally derived ingredients with a low-residue, low-VOC profile.

products.title: UTILEX - PEROXY
products.active: Peroxyacetic acid 10-15%, acetic acid 10-15%, and hydrogen peroxide 15-18%
products.molecule: A peroxyacid blend that oxidizes microorganisms rapidly during CIP and rinse-off disinfection cycles.
products.dilution: Dilution: 1% or 10 ml/ltr. Contact time: 1 to 5 minutes depending on the process and contamination load.
products.impact: Built for US FDA GRAS-aligned food-contact hygiene with reduced time, water, and energy usage.

products.title: UTILEX SAN+
products.active: Non-rinse quat plus biguanide disinfectant concentrate
products.molecule: A concentrated no-rinse disinfectant for hard surfaces and reusable surgical equipment after cleaning.
products.dilution: Dilution: 1% or 10 ml in 990 ml water for 200 ppm BKC. Use as a manual mist spray, last-step CIP, or flood application.
products.impact: Designed to save time and water while supporting food-safe disinfection at the required concentration.

products.title: Quatfog Disinfectant Concentrate
products.active: Dimethyl benzyl ammonium chloride 8% w/v and didecyl dimethyl ammonium chloride 8% w/v
products.molecule: A quaternary ammonium fogging blend intended for wet-surface disinfection in non-food-contact areas.
products.dilution: Dilution: 1:100 for 800 ppm DBAC and DDAC. Wet the area with a fogging machine and ventilate after use.
products.impact: Built for controlled fogging applications with a clear PPE and ventilation workflow.

products.title: STERIX Washroom RTU Cleaner & Sanitizer
products.active: Eco-acid cleaner with citric chelates and green acid system
products.molecule: A washroom cleaner that combines eco-acids and citric chelates for high-traffic WC and urinal maintenance.
products.dilution: Ready to use. Apply, brush, scrub, and flush as required for routine washroom maintenance.
products.impact: Formulated to stay EDTA free, NTA free, and safer for aquatic discharge than inorganic-acid cleaners.

products.title: Fresh Sterix Urinal Line Deodourizer Concentrate
products.active: Urinal line deodorizer concentrate with naturally derived solubilizers
products.molecule: A deodorizer concentrate intended for urinal line maintenance and routine restroom freshness.
products.dilution: Use as supplied or at the indicated super-concentrate dilution. Apply and refresh according to traffic load.
products.impact: A low-residue fragrance product designed for better indoor air quality in washrooms.

products.title: Zing+ Super Concentrate Air Freshener
products.active: IFRA-compliant phthalate-free fragrance in a synthetic solvent free base
products.molecule: A fragrance delivery system that uses naturally derived solubilizers and solvent-free handling for indoor freshness.
products.dilution: Dilution: 1% with IFRA-compliant use instructions. Apply in ventilated areas and refresh as needed.
products.impact: Designed to deliver fragrance without synthetic solvent carriers and with reduced airborne residue.

products.title: ELQ F Food Grade Un-fragranced Hand Wash
products.active: Laureth sulfate with aloe vera and glycerine
products.molecule: A skin-friendly hand wash base designed to foam well, rinse quickly, and feel moisturized after use.
products.dilution: Use as supplied in dispenser pumps. Wet hands, lather, rinse, and dry after standard hand hygiene steps.
products.impact: Built without slurry soap oil and with a focus on frequent-use hygiene in food and institutional settings.

products.title: Fresh Hands ELQ Economy Gel Hand Wash
products.active: Medium-foam citrus hand wash with skin-friendly surfactants
products.molecule: A hand wash that balances regular-feel cleansing with a quick-rinse user experience for high-traffic washrooms.
products.dilution: Use as supplied in dispensers. Apply, lather, rinse, and dry after the recommended wash cycle.
products.impact: Designed for routine hand hygiene with a softer fragrance and easier rinse profile.

products.title: Fresh Hands Pearl Pearly Hand Wash
products.active: Medium-foam pearly hand wash with creamy feel
products.molecule: A pearly textured hand wash designed to feel premium while keeping rinse time and residue low.
products.dilution: Use as supplied. Wet hands, work into a lather, rinse thoroughly, and dry.
products.impact: Suitable for frequent handwashing with a balanced sensory profile and gentle rinse-off.

products.title: Fresh Hands Foam Hand Wash for Foam Dispenser
products.active: High-foam, low-use hand wash base for foam dispensers
products.molecule: A concentrated foam hand wash tuned for high-lather output and a fast rinse cycle.
products.dilution: Use in foam dispensers as supplied. Apply one or two pumps, lather, rinse, and dry.
products.impact: Optimized to reduce product use per wash while keeping a premium foam feel.

products.title: Fresh Hands LQ Gel Hand Wash
products.active: High-foam floral gel hand wash with easy rinse profile
products.molecule: A deluxe gel hand wash made for a softer finish and good user experience in public washrooms.
products.dilution: Use as supplied in handwash dispensers. Lather, rinse, and dry after the standard wash cycle.
products.impact: Geared toward high-traffic environments where fragrance, foam, and rinse speed all matter.

products.title: UTILEX-L Multi Kitchen & Dish Cleaner
products.active: Lemon extract food-surface detergent with higher foam
products.molecule: A kitchen detergent built for manual scrubbing and rinsing on food-contact surfaces.
products.dilution: Use at the indicated 2% to 5% range depending on soil level and rinse-off requirement.
products.impact: US FDA GRAS-aligned for food-contact hygiene with a focus on lower residue and better rinse performance.

products.title: UTILEX-M Auto Dishwash Detergent
products.active: Machine dishwashing liquid for automatic cycles
products.molecule: A machine dishwashing liquid intended for automatic wash cycles and food-safe rinse workflows.
products.dilution: Use in automatic machine dosing at the specified low-dilution range for effective dishwash cycles.
products.impact: Formulated to work within US FDA GRAS-oriented food hygiene expectations and faster drying cycles.

products.title: UTILEX-R Auto Dishwash Rinse Aid
products.active: Machine dishwash rinse aid for faster drying and spot-free finish
products.molecule: A rinse-aid system that helps water sheet off plates, glasses, and utensils more efficiently.
products.dilution: Use in the rinse stage of the machine cycle as directed for low-residue drying.
products.impact: Supports quicker drying and reduced spotting without introducing harsh solvent load.

products.title: UTILEX III Disinfectant Kitchen Wash
products.active: Benzalkonium Chloride 3% w/v with food-safe surfactants and chelates
products.molecule: A neutral foaming kitchen disinfectant for manual scrub, rinse, and spray-clean use.
products.dilution: Use at 2% to 5% depending on surface type and soil load, then rinse off as needed.
products.impact: Designed for food-industry hygiene with a rinse-off profile and lower solvent dependence.

products.title: UTILEX Chlor Tab Disinfectant Kitchen Tablet
products.active: Chlorine tablet disinfectant for kitchen hygiene use
products.molecule: A tablet-based disinfecting format intended for kitchen and food-prep sanitation workflows.
products.dilution: Dissolve and use at the instructed working concentration for manual or CIP sanitation.
products.impact: Packaged to simplify dosing while keeping the food-hygiene workflow controlled and repeatable.

products.title: UTILEX DRAIN Alkaline Drain Cleaner
products.active: Alkaline drain cleaning chemistry for blockages and grease removal
products.molecule: An alkaline cleaner formulated for drain maintenance and grease breakup in service areas.
products.dilution: Use as directed for drain maintenance and grease removal. Rinse after treatment if required.
products.impact: Designed to address blockages without introducing unnecessary synthetic solvent load.

products.title: LAUNDRO MULSE Super Enzyme Regular Non Ionic Booster
products.active: Regular Non Ionic Booster with Enzymes (Neutral Alkalinity)
products.molecule: A neutral non-ionic emulsifier boosted with high-activity enzymes for extra dirty and greasy linen.
products.dilution: Dosage: 2–4 ml/Kg Dry Load | Cycle: 15–25 mins | Temp: 30 to 90 Deg. C | Compatible: Laundro Shot, Det, Excel, Complete, Kleen, Det-L (Also Bleach-O & Chlor)
products.impact: Dual enzyme and surfactant action breaks down tough protein stains and complex grease loads.

products.title: LAUNDRO OXYDET Liquid Detergent + Oxygen Bleach
products.active: Liquid detergent plus oxygen bleach for main wash cycles
products.molecule: A combined detergent and oxygen-bleach laundry system for whites and coloureds.
products.dilution: Use in the main wash cycle at the directed dosage and temperature profile.
products.impact: Supports non-chlorine laundry processing with a lower environmental footprint.

products.title: LAUNDRO ACTIV Laundro Oxydet Accelerator
products.active: Oxydet accelerator for hospital linen cycles
products.molecule: An acidic accelerator designed to be used only with the oxygen-bleach laundry system.
products.dilution: Use only with LAUNDRO OXYDET as directed in the brochure cycle guide.
products.impact: Supports a lower-temperature, higher-performance wash sequence for controlled laundry handling.

products.title: LAUNDRO DET & L High Surf Liquid Detergent
products.active: High-surf liquid detergent for cotton and polycot blends
products.molecule: A low-soda detergent for heavy soil loads on everyday institutional laundry.
products.dilution: Use in pre-soak or final rinse workflows as indicated in the brochure guidance.
products.impact: Built for better wash performance with lower alkalinity and improved rinse behavior.

products.title: LAUNDRO BOOST LHP & P
products.active: Booster for detergent, bleach, and neutralizer cycles
products.molecule: A cycle booster intended to support detergent, bleach, and rinse efficiency in heavier laundry workloads.
products.dilution: Use at the specified 2 to 8 ml/Kg range depending on the wash stage and soil condition.
products.impact: Helps improve wash performance while keeping the dosing low and controlled.

products.title: LAUNDRO KLEEN
products.active: Neutral bleach-cycle cleaner for green and white linen
products.molecule: A neutral bleach-cycle laundry helper designed for the dedicated stand-alone step in the process.
products.dilution: Use in the stand-alone bleach cycle according to the temperature and dosing table.
products.impact: Designed to keep the bleach cycle controlled while preserving biodegradability and rinse quality.

products.title: LAUNDRO BLEACH - O Activated Powder Oxygen Bleach
products.active: Activated powder oxygen bleach
products.molecule: An activated oxygen bleach for linen whitening without chlorine-based chemistry.
products.dilution: Use at the indicated 4 to 8 gm/Kg dosage in the main wash cycle.
products.impact: Supports a non-chlorine laundry system with lower chlorine residue and better environmental profile.

products.title: LAUNDRO BLEACH - OL Accelerated Liquid Oxygen Bleach
products.active: Accelerated liquid oxygen bleach
products.molecule: A liquid oxygen bleach that fits the accelerated laundry cycle for hospital and institutional linen.
products.dilution: Use at the specified 2 to 6 ml/Kg dosage range depending on the wash load.
products.impact: Keeps the bleach cycle chlorine free while preserving strong whitening performance.

products.title: LAUNDRO MULSE - E Speciality Non Ionic Booster
products.active: Speciality Non Ionic Booster (Neutral Alkalinity)
products.molecule: A neutral-pH speciality non-ionic liquid emulsifier and booster engineered for F&B and greasy industrial linen.
products.dilution: Dosage: 2–6 ml/Kg Dry Load | Cycle: 15–25 mins | Temp: 30 to 90 Deg. C | Compatible: Laundro Shot, Det, Excel, Complete, Kleen, Det-L (Also Bleach-O & Chlor)
products.impact: High-efficiency grease removal and emulsification across 30–90°C without altering wash pH.

products.title: LAUNDRO MULSE
products.active: Neutral laundry emulsifier for hospital green and white linen
products.molecule: A neutral emulsifier for everyday institutional laundry handling and combination wash use.
products.dilution: Use in combination with the indicated cycle products at 2 to 6 ml/Kg.
products.impact: Keeps the laundry process low-soda and low-residue for repeated washing.

products.title: LAUNDRO SAN Liquid Linen Germ Fighting Rinse
products.active: Liquid linen germ-fighting rinse
products.molecule: A post-wash rinse designed for hospital linen and germ-control workflows.
products.dilution: Use as a standalone final-rinse product at the brochure-specified dosing level.
products.impact: Supports a controlled laundry finish with lower residue and improved rinse hygiene.

products.title: LAUNDRO RINSE Neuteralizing Liquid Rinse
products.active: Organic-acid neutralizing liquid rinse
products.molecule: A neutralizing rinse that helps close the wash cycle cleanly after detergent, bleach, or sanitizer steps.
products.dilution: Use at the indicated 2 to 4 ml/Kg dosage after the non-chlorine rinse cycle.
products.impact: Designed to reduce residual alkalinity while keeping the rinse stage pleasant and controlled.

products.title: StrongKleen Descalant & Decement
products.active: Acidic descaling and decement chemistry
products.molecule: An acidic maintenance cleaner for scale and cement removal on industrial surfaces.
products.dilution: Use at the indicated 1:10 to RTU range, scrub, and rinse as required.
products.impact: Designed to reduce scale and cement build-up without relying on harsher solvent systems.

products.title: FLORSHINE Marble Floor Crystalizer
products.active: Acidic marble crystallizer for floor shine
products.molecule: A floor crystalizer designed for marble surfaces that need renewed gloss and hardness.
products.dilution: Apply ready to use, then scrub, rinse, and buff following the brochure guidance.
products.impact: Built to improve appearance while keeping the floor care workflow straightforward.

products.title: FLORPOL Powder Polish & Crystalizer
products.active: Neutral pH powder polish and crystalizer
products.molecule: A neutral powder polish used to restore shine and controlled crystalization on stone floors.
products.dilution: Use in the 2% to RTU range, then scrub and rinse according to the surface condition.
products.impact: Keeps polishing chemistry simple while staying free from volatile petroleum smell.

products.title: H-Kleen Super Hard Surface Degreaser
products.active: Highly alkaline hard-surface degreaser
products.molecule: A strong degreaser built for heavy surface soil on industrial and utility areas.
products.dilution: Use at the indicated 10% to RTU range, then scrub and rinse.
products.impact: Intended for difficult grease removal while keeping the product catalog aligned to safer chemistry.

products.title: H-Kleen HDg Carbon & Heavy Grease Remover
products.active: Alkaline carbon and heavy grease remover
products.molecule: An alkaline cleaner targeted at carbon deposits and stubborn grease films.
products.dilution: Use at the indicated 2% to 5% range, then scrub and rinse.
products.impact: Designed for tougher industrial soils without moving into harsher solvent-heavy territory.

products.title: Alkagrease Heavy Duty Degreaser
products.active: Heavy-duty alkaline degreasing chemistry
products.molecule: A concentrated degreaser for industrial and utility soils that need manual scrub action.
products.dilution: Use at the 2% to 5% range based on the grease load and scrub requirement.
products.impact: A focused degreasing system for demanding cleanup while keeping rinse handling clear and simple.

products.title: CarpetKleen HF High Foam Shampoo
products.active: High-foam carpet shampoo for extraction and spotting
products.molecule: A carpet shampoo designed for use with spray extraction machines and spot cleaning.
products.dilution: Use at the normal-soil or heavy-soil dilution recommended in the brochure and dry after extraction.
products.impact: Supports carpet cleaning with a foaming profile and without heavy petroleum-style odor.

products.title: CarpetKleen LF Low Foam Stain Removal
products.active: Low-foaming alkaline carpet shampoo for spray extraction machines
products.molecule: A low-foam carpet shampoo optimized for extraction machines and controlled spot treatment.
products.dilution: Use at 50 to 75 ml/L for normal soiling or 100 to 150 ml/L for heavy soil.
products.impact: Helps reduce moisture and foam load during carpet maintenance and drying.

products.title: Metalex Rust Oxidiation Remover
products.active: Acidic rust and oxidation remover
products.molecule: A rust-treatment formula intended for oxidation marks and metal cleaning tasks.
products.dilution: Apply directly, scrub, and rinse where needed; follow the hidden-spot test guidance for sensitive surfaces.
products.impact: Keeps metal restoration practical while limiting unnecessary solvent use.

products.title: Stainex-Sc Scrub Paste Hard Surface
products.active: Scrub paste stain remover for hard surfaces
products.molecule: A micro-scrub paste that dissolves deposited stains using a surfactant and solvent blend.
products.dilution: Apply directly on the stain, scrub well, and rinse. Repeated use may be required on very old stains.
products.impact: Intended for difficult stain removal while preserving a controlled scrub-paste workflow.

products.title: Stainex-G Oil, Grease Remover
products.active: Neutral to alkaline oil and grease remover
products.molecule: A spot-treatment product for greasy deposits on hard and semi-porous surfaces.
products.dilution: Use at the indicated 2% to 5% range or as an external spot treatment.
products.impact: Designed to reduce grease without introducing heavy petroleum odor.

products.title: MULTIPOL Wood, Leather Multi Surface
products.active: Wood and leather multi-surface polish
products.molecule: A polish designed for wood and leather surfaces that need quick dry and easy buffing.
products.dilution: Apply as directed in the brochure, then buff or wipe to the required finish.
products.impact: Built for low-odor polishing in Indian conditions with minimal petroleum smell.

products.title: STEELPOL Steel Polish
products.active: Neutral pH steel polish
products.molecule: A neutral polish for stainless steel and related metal surfaces that need a clean, fast-dry finish.
products.dilution: Apply ready to use, then wipe and buff to the desired finish.
products.impact: Designed to keep metal polishing easy without a petroleum-style smell.

products.title: APC-F Green Multipurpose Floor & Hard Surface Cleaner
products.active: Benzalkonium Chloride 3% w/v with food-safe surfactants and chelates
products.molecule: Benzalkonium chloride and neutral surfactants lift soil while keeping the formula safe for spray, mop, and machine scrub use.
products.dilution: Dilution: 1:100 to 1:50, or 1% to 2% (10 ml/ltr to 20 ml/ltr) depending on soil load. Spray and wipe, mop, or machine scrub.
products.impact: Readily biodegradable formula free from NPE, caustic, EDTA, phosphate, and synthetic solvents; designed for safer effluent and aquatic life.

products.title: LAUNDRO DET Powder Detergent & Booster
products.active: Powder Detergent & Booster (Medium High Alkalinity - Caustic Free)
products.molecule: A medium-high alkalinity caustic-free powder detergent and booster for generic institutional laundry.
products.dilution: Dosage: 4–6 gms/Kg Dry Load | Cycle: 15–25 mins | Temp: 30 to 90 Deg. C | Compatible: Same Cycle (Laundro Mulse E & Super, Laundro Bleach-O)
products.impact: Delivers powerful detergency and alkalinity boost without caustic soda, preserving linen life.

products.title: LAUNDRO DET - EC Economic Powder Detergent & Booster
products.active: Economic Powder Detergent & Booster (High Alkalinity)
products.molecule: An economical high-alkalinity powder detergent and booster designed for heavy soil removal on tough institutional linen.
products.dilution: Dosage: 4–6 gms/Kg Dry Load | Cycle: 15–25 mins | Temp: 30 to 90 Deg. C | Compatible: Same Cycle (Laundro Mulse E & Super, Laundro Bleach-O)
products.impact: High efficiency soil saponification for tough industrial and institutional linen.

products.title: LAUNDRO COMPLETE All-in-One Sensitive Oxy Detergent
products.active: All-in-One Sensitive Oxy Detergent (Low Alkalinity - No Soda)
products.molecule: An all-in-one sensitive oxygen bleach powder detergent formulated without soda ash for high-end laundry.
products.dilution: Dosage: 4–5 gms/Kg Dry Load | Cycle: 15–20 mins | Temp: 40 to 60 Deg. C | Compatible: Same Cycle (Laundro Mulse E & Super)
products.impact: Combines gentle detersive action and oxygen bleaching with zero soda ash to maximize fabric longevity.

products.title: LAUNDRO EXCEL All-in-One Powerful Oxy Detergent
products.active: All-in-One Powerful Oxy Detergent (Medium Alkalinity - Caustic Free)
products.molecule: A powerful all-in-one detergent + active oxygen bleach formulation with medium caustic-free alkalinity.
products.dilution: Dosage: 4–5 gms/Kg Dry Load | Cycle: 15–20 mins | Temp: 40 to 60 Deg. C | Compatible: Same Cycle (Laundro Mulse E & Super)
products.impact: Provides single-stage heavy soil cleaning and color-safe oxygen whitening in one operation.
